scope: All eight frozen citation-bearing claims and all seven ordinary body-flow bibliography keys were checked against primary paper text, publisher records, or primary book text; bibliography coverage, exact locators, hypotheses, convention boundaries, and the absence of unsupported priority claims were included.
citation_audit_method: two-stage frozen-claim extraction followed by serial primary-source passage and publication-record verification under the citation-check and BibTeX-audit protocols; subagents were not used because this bounded job explicitly prohibited them
